headline: State Senator Mallory McMorrow expressed confidence in Democratic victories across Michigan, emphasizing voter desire for change and the party's pursuit of a state government trifecta.
health_summary: Senator McMorrow did not make any statements about health or health care during this interview. Her remarks focused on voter sentiment regarding economic conditions, support for down-ballot candidates, and the prospect of a Democratic trifecta in Lansing.

priorities.speaker: mcmorrow
priorities.label: Support U.S. Senate candidate
priorities.quote: The work is bigger than who's on the ballot. So, I threw 100% behind the pool uh immediately after the primary helping out.

priorities.speaker: mcmorrow
priorities.label: Address economic concerns
priorities.quote: That people are ready for change. You know, this was the second Trump presidency he got back into the White House on a promise of bringing jobs back and not starting any more wars and creating more opportunity for people. He's done none of those things.

priorities.speaker: mcmorrow
priorities.label: Elect Democrats to trifecta
priorities.quote: We're going to have a trifecta going into 2027. I am so thrilled um to have been supporting 16 candidates for state house and state senate.

priorities.speaker: mcmorrow
priorities.label: Build grassroots energy statewide
priorities.quote: I've been at canvas kickoffs all across the state. We were just in the canvas kickoff this past week with Jane Mayo in Jackson. We had 30 people show up for a state house race on a Friday.
